decisions.reason: Applying the FCC/FH dates consistently to the Term section and Schedule table does not change any allocated-budget amount or basis.
The date-placement decision does not change the agreement display name or the relationships among FCC, FH, 154Q, and 201.
Using the supplied dates in both document locations does not change the independently specified four-week value.
The date consistency decision has no effect on the required signature or its placement in the subcontractor section.
The decision about where to use the FCC/FH dates does not alter the explanation of the difference between the full allocation and subcontract amount.
The source resolves conflicting date displays but does not change the total-session calculation method, labor inputs, or adjustment policy.
Applying dates consistently does not change how a budget gap is allocated or which non-personnel categories are permitted.
The source confirms matching dates in the identified Term and Schedule locations but does not change whether the salary and wages support sheet is included.
